## Noah Kahan Reaches No. 1 on the Billboard 200

American singer-songwriter Noah Kahan has achieved his first No. 1 album on the Billboard 200 chart. His fourth studio album, **"The Great Divide,"** debuted at the top spot with an impressive 389,000 equivalent album units in its first week.

### What Are "Equivalent Album Units"?

The Billboard 200 chart measures album popularity using a system called "equivalent album units." This system counts not just physical album sales, but also digital downloads and music streams. For example, a certain number of streams from a streaming platform like Spotify or Apple Music counts as one album unit. Billboard began using this measurement system at the end of 2014.

### A Historic Week for Rock Music

Kahan's first-week numbers are not just a personal milestone — they are historic for rock music. "The Great Divide" recorded the biggest opening week for a rock album since Billboard switched to the unit-based measurement system in late 2014. This means no other rock album in over a decade has sold and streamed as strongly as Kahan's new record in its first week.

The album also ranks as one of the third-biggest opening weeks for any album across all genres in recent years, showing just how wide Kahan's audience has grown.

### Who Is Noah Kahan?

Noah Kahan is a singer-songwriter from Vermont, a small state in the northeastern United States. He is known for his folk-rock style, emotionally honest lyrics, and warm acoustic sound. He first gained wider attention with his 2022 album **"Stick Season,"** which became a slow-building hit thanks largely to social media platforms like TikTok. Songs like "Stick Season" and "Dial Drunk" connected deeply with younger listeners, helping him build a large and loyal fanbase.

"The Great Divide" is his fourth full-length album and represents a major step forward in his career. Reaching No. 1 on the Billboard 200 is considered one of the highest achievements in the American music industry.

### A Growing Star

Kahan's success with "The Great Divide" shows that rock and folk-rock music still has a strong audience, even in an era dominated by pop and hip-hop. His rise also highlights how streaming platforms and social media have changed the way artists can build their careers — sometimes without heavy support from traditional radio.

Fans and music critics have praised the album for its honest storytelling and powerful melodies. With this No. 1 debut, Noah Kahan has firmly established himself as one of the most important rock artists working today.

## 'The Pitt' Star Isa Briones Speaks Out Against Disruptive Fans at Broadway Show

Actress Isa Briones, known for her role in the TV drama **"The Pitt,"** has publicly called out fans who disrupted her Broadway performance by screaming at her during the show. She shared her frustration on social media, describing the behavior as disrespectful to everyone in the theater.

### What Happened?

On Saturday, Briones posted a message on social media addressing fans who had been shouting at her while she was performing on stage. In her post, she began with "Hey, hey, hey!" before expressing her strong feelings about the situation.

She made it clear that screaming at a performer during a live stage show is not acceptable. She called the behavior "f---ing disrespectful" — language that shows just how frustrated and upset she was by the experience.

### Isa Briones: TV Star on the Broadway Stage

Briones is currently starring in the Broadway jukebox musical **"Just In Time,"** where she plays the role of **Connie Francis**, a famous American pop singer from the 1950s and 1960s. A jukebox musical is a type of stage show that is built around well-known songs by a real artist or from a particular era.

Outside of Broadway, Briones is widely recognized for playing **Dr. Trinity Santos**, a second-year medical resident, in the TV series "The Pitt." The show has earned strong reviews and helped Briones gain a much larger public profile.

### Why Is This a Problem?

When fans recognize a celebrity in a live performance and react by calling out or screaming, it can seriously disrupt the show. Unlike a concert, where audience noise is usually welcome, a Broadway musical requires focus and quiet from the audience so that performers can deliver their lines and songs clearly.

Disruptive behavior can also ruin the experience for other audience members who have paid for their tickets and want to enjoy the show without interruptions.

### A Wider Conversation About Fan Behavior

Briones' post is part of a growing conversation about how fans should behave around celebrities, both in public and at live events. In recent years, many performers and public figures have spoken out about overly aggressive or inconsiderate fan behavior.

While enthusiasm for a favorite actor or singer is natural, many in the entertainment industry argue that there is an important line between showing appreciation and causing disruption.

Briones' message was direct and honest. She did not want to shame her fans, but she did want them to understand that respectful behavior allows everyone — performers and audience members alike — to have a better experience.

Pop star Olivia Rodrigo had a very busy night on the popular American comedy show *Saturday Night Live* (SNL). She took on two big roles at the same time — she was both the host of the show and the musical guest.

**What Is SNL?**

*Saturday Night Live* is a long-running live comedy and sketch show on American television. It has been on the air since 1975. Each week, a celebrity hosts the show and a musical artist performs. It is quite rare for one person to do both jobs in the same episode. When someone hosts and performs, it is called "playing double duty."

**A New Song with Weyes Blood**

One of the highlights of the night was Olivia Rodrigo performing a brand-new song together with the artist Weyes Blood. Weyes Blood, whose real name is Natalie Mering, is known for her rich, cinematic sound and poetic lyrics. Performing a new song live on national television is a bold move, as there is no second chance if something goes wrong. Fans were excited to hear fresh material from Rodrigo.

**Special Guests on the Show**

The episode also featured some well-known guests. Debbie Harry, the legendary lead singer of the rock band Blondie, made an appearance. Harry is considered a pioneer of punk and new wave music from the late 1970s and 1980s. Her presence on the show was a special moment for music fans of all ages.

Comedian and actor Aziz Ansari also appeared as a guest during the episode. Ansari is well known for his stand-up comedy and for creating and starring in the Netflix series *Master of None*.

**Olivia Rodrigo's Rising Star**

Olivia Rodrigo first became famous in 2021 with her debut single "drivers license," which broke many streaming records. Her albums *SOUR* and *GUTS* were both critically praised and commercially successful. She is widely seen as one of the most talented young artists in pop music today.

Hosting SNL while also performing is a sign of how far she has come as an entertainer. It takes confidence, skill, and hard work to handle both responsibilities in front of a live audience.

## Australia's Budget and Political News

### $500 Million for Faster Approvals

The Australian federal government is preparing its budget for this year. One major plan is to spend **$500 million** to speed up environmental approvals. These approvals are needed before housing developments, energy projects, and mining operations can begin.

Currently, getting approval for large projects can take a very long time. The government hopes this new funding will make the process faster, helping Australia build more homes and develop more energy sources more quickly.

### Government Brings Home Passengers from Hantavirus Ship

In other news, the Australian government has repatriated — meaning brought back to their home country — passengers who were on a ship connected to a hantavirus outbreak. Hantavirus is a serious illness that people can catch from contact with infected rodents. The government acted to ensure the safety of Australian citizens who were on board.

### Barnaby Joyce Rejects One Nation Coalition

In politics, former Deputy Prime Minister Barnaby Joyce made headlines by saying **no** to One Nation joining the Coalition. The Coalition is a formal alliance of conservative political parties in Australia.

One Nation recently celebrated winning its **first federal lower house seat**, which means the party is growing in popularity. Joyce acknowledged this, saying the party is "on the up and up" and could even "go for government" in the future.

However, Joyce was clear that he does not want a formal partnership. He explained his position this way:

> "We'll offer supply and confidence on policy outcomes… and that is not a Coalition. We don't want your ministries, keep your ministries and your salaries."

In simple terms, Joyce is saying: One Nation can support the government on specific policies, but it should not become a full member of the Coalition. He does not want One Nation to share in government roles or salaries.

### Cabinet Solidarity Concerns

Joyce also criticized the idea of **cabinet solidarity**. This is a rule in government where all ministers must publicly agree with Cabinet decisions, even if they personally disagree. Joyce believes this system has hurt both the Australian people and conservative politics.

He argued that One Nation should stay independent so it can freely push for policies that benefit its voters, without being limited by coalition rules.

### Skilled Visas Still Important

Joyce also spoke about immigration. He said he will continue to fight for **skilled visas** in his region of Farrer, which relies heavily on workers from overseas. He mentioned programs like the **Pacific Australia Labour Mobility (PALM) scheme** and skilled aged care nursing programs, saying these are still important and will continue.

He described the recent election result not as a protest vote, but as voters looking for a better future:

> "It was a vote of relief, someone seeking a better future."

### Key Takeaway

Australia is navigating a busy political period — with new budget spending, a growing One Nation party, and ongoing debates about immigration and political alliances. These developments will shape the country's direction in the months ahead.

## Life Inside Iran: Civilians Speak Out

### An Internet Ban in Iran

The Iranian government has imposed an **internet ban**. This means people inside Iran cannot freely use the internet. They cannot easily access news from outside the country, and it is very difficult for them to share information with the rest of the world.

Governments sometimes block the internet during times of conflict or political unrest. They often do this to control the flow of information and prevent people from organizing protests or sharing news that the government does not want others to see.

### How the BBC Got the Story

Despite the internet restrictions, BBC special correspondent **Fergal Keane** was able to hear from people living inside Iran. He used **trusted sources** — people who could safely communicate information from inside the country.

This kind of reporting is very important. When a government limits communication, it becomes harder for the outside world to understand what is really happening. Journalists rely on brave local sources to share the truth.

### Trauma from Conflict and Repression

The people Keane spoke with described being **traumatised** — deeply hurt emotionally — by two major problems:

1. **War and conflict** — Fighting and violence have caused fear, loss, and suffering for many ordinary Iranian civilians. A civilian is a person who is not a soldier — just a regular person living their daily life.

2. **Government repression** — "Repression" means the government uses force or strict control to stop people from speaking freely or protesting. Many Iranians are afraid to speak out because of potential punishment.

These two pressures together — the danger of conflict and the fear of the government — make daily life extremely difficult and frightening for many people inside Iran.

### Why This Matters

Iran has faced significant political tensions in recent years. Many citizens, especially young people and women, have protested against the government's strict rules. The government has responded harshly in many cases, arresting protesters and limiting freedoms.

At the same time, tensions in the wider Middle East region have added to the sense of danger and uncertainty that ordinary Iranians feel every day.

### The Role of Journalism

Reports like Fergal Keane's are important because they give a **voice to civilians** who cannot easily speak for themselves. When governments try to hide what is happening by cutting off the internet, independent journalism helps ensure that the world can still hear the truth.

For the people inside Iran who shared their stories, speaking to the BBC was likely a risk. Their courage allows the international community to better understand the human cost of conflict and political repression.

## Trump Administration Considers Pausing Federal Gas Tax

The Trump administration is thinking about temporarily stopping the federal gas tax to help lower fuel prices for American drivers. The U.S. Energy Secretary announced this idea as the government looks for ways to reduce costs at the gas pump.

### What Is the Federal Gas Tax?

The federal gas tax is a charge that the U.S. government adds to every gallon of gasoline sold in the country. Right now, this tax is a little over **18 cents per gallon**. This money is usually used to pay for building and repairing roads, bridges, and highways across the country.

### Why Is the Government Considering This?

Gas prices in the United States have been very high recently. The average national price for a gallon of gasoline is currently above **$4.50**. This is a significant burden for many families, especially those who drive long distances to work or live in areas without good public transportation.

By pausing the gas tax, the government hopes that gas stations would lower their prices, saving drivers some money every time they fill up their tanks. This kind of temporary removal of a fuel tax is sometimes called a "gas tax holiday."

### Will It Actually Help?

Many economists and experts are doubtful that this measure will provide much real relief. Here is why:

- The tax is only about **18 cents per gallon**, which is a small amount compared to the total price of $4.50 or more.
- Even if the full 18 cents were removed, a driver filling a 15-gallon tank would save only about **$2.70** per visit to the gas station.
- There is no guarantee that oil companies or gas stations would actually pass the full savings on to customers. They might keep some of the money as extra profit instead.

### A Bigger Picture

High gas prices affect more than just individual drivers. When transportation costs go up, businesses also pay more to move goods from one place to another. This can lead to higher prices for everyday products in stores, adding to inflation.

A gas tax holiday has been tried before. During periods of high oil prices in the past, some U.S. states have temporarily paused their own state gas taxes. The results were mixed — some drivers saw small savings, but the impact was generally limited.

### What Happens Next?

The administration has not yet made a final decision. Pausing the federal gas tax would likely need approval from the U.S. Congress, which could make the process slow or difficult. Some lawmakers may oppose the idea because removing the tax would reduce funding for road and infrastructure projects.

For now, American drivers continue to pay high prices at the pump while the government considers its options.

## Tradespeople Struggle with Late Payments and Price Negotiations

Plumbers, electricians, builders, and other skilled tradespeople across the UK are facing a growing financial headache. According to a recent survey, more than half of tradespeople have experienced an increase in **late payments** compared to a year ago. This is adding serious pressure to their businesses during an already difficult economic period.

### Who Are Tradespeople?

Tradespeople are skilled workers who do practical jobs, such as fixing pipes, wiring homes, laying floors, or building walls. Many of them run their own small businesses or work as self-employed contractors. Unlike workers who receive a regular salary, tradespeople are often paid after they finish a job — which means late payments can seriously hurt their income.

### The Late Payment Problem

When a customer delays paying for work that has already been completed, the tradesperson still has costs to cover — tools, materials, fuel, and even their own living expenses. If too many customers pay late, a small business can quickly run into serious cash flow problems.

The survey found that this situation has been getting worse. More customers appear to be struggling to pay their bills on time, likely because of the **cost of living crisis** — a period when the prices of everyday goods, energy, and housing have risen sharply, leaving many people with less money to spend.

### Haggling Over Prices

Another major challenge for tradespeople is customers trying to **haggle**, or negotiate, over the price of work. In tough economic times, people naturally look for ways to spend less money. However, for tradespeople, cutting prices can be very difficult because the cost of materials — like copper pipes, electrical cables, and timber — has also gone up significantly.

This means tradespeople are caught in a difficult situation:
- Customers want to pay less.
- The cost of doing the job has gone up.
- Payments are arriving later than before.

### Chasing Debts

When customers do not pay on time, tradespeople sometimes have to spend time and energy **chasing debts** — repeatedly contacting customers to ask for the money they are owed. This takes time away from actually doing work and earning money. Some tradespeople may even need to hire a debt collection service, which adds another cost to their business.

### A Difficult Time for Small Businesses

The findings highlight how the cost of living crisis is not just affecting ordinary households — it is also putting enormous pressure on small businesses. Tradespeople provide essential services that people rely on every day, but they are finding it increasingly hard to keep their businesses running smoothly.

Experts suggest that clear payment agreements, written contracts, and deposits paid before work begins can all help reduce the risk of late payments. However, in a competitive market, many tradespeople worry that asking for strict payment terms might cause them to lose customers altogether.

## The Bastl Kalimba: A Synth That Looks Like a Thumb Piano

The Bastl Kalimba is a very unusual musical instrument. At first glance, it looks just like a kalimba — a small African thumb piano that you play by plucking thin metal strips called **tines**. But this instrument is actually a **synthesizer**, which is an electronic device that creates sound artificially.

### How Does It Work?

On a real kalimba, the tines vibrate and make sound when you pluck them. On the Bastl Kalimba, however, the tines are mostly silent. Instead, they work as **touch and velocity-sensitive triggers**. This means they detect how hard and how fast you press them, and then send that information to an electronic sound engine inside the instrument.

That sound engine uses two technologies: **physical modeling** and **FM synthesis**. Physical modeling means the computer simulates how a real instrument would sound. FM synthesis is a classic electronic method for creating a wide range of tones. Together, they give the Bastl Kalimba a huge variety of sounds.

### A Little Bit of Real Sound

There is also a small microphone inside the instrument. Players can mix in some real acoustic sound from the tines if they want a more natural feel. This adds a little "acoustic spice" to the mostly electronic sound.

### What Sounds Can It Make?

The Bastl Kalimba can sound somewhat like a real kalimba, but it can also produce many other sounds. These include:

- **Pluck sounds** — short, sharp notes like a guitar or harp
- **Pad sounds** — long, smooth sounds that hold in the air
- A wide range of other electronic tones

The instrument also has **built-in effects**. These include:

- **Delay** — an echo effect that repeats the sound
- **Reverb** — a effect that makes it sound like you are playing in a large room
- **Distortion** — a rougher, edgier sound effect

### Already a Big Success

The Bastl Kalimba has been very popular even before it officially goes on sale. It raised over **$700,000 on Kickstarter**, a website where people can give money to support new products and ideas. This shows that many musicians are excited about an instrument that combines the familiar, simple feel of a thumb piano with the power and flexibility of a modern synthesizer.

### Why Is It Interesting?

The Bastl Kalimba is interesting because it makes synthesizer technology feel **approachable and fun**. Many synthesizers have lots of complicated buttons and screens. The kalimba design is simple and natural — you just use your thumbs. At the same time, the instrument is powerful enough for professional musicians who want to create unique electronic sounds.

It is a great example of how modern technology can be combined with traditional instrument designs to create something completely new.

## Ashnymph's *Childhood* EP: Dance Goth Rock at Its Most Exciting

Sometimes the best music recommendations come from old friends. That is exactly how many listeners have been introduced to **Ashnymph**, a London-based band whose debut EP, *Childhood*, has been turning heads in underground music circles.

### Who Are Ashnymph?

Ashnymph is a band from London that blends several distinct musical styles into one thrilling sound. Their music draws from:

- **Post-punk** — the dark, angular rock style that emerged after punk in the late 1970s and early 1980s
- **Krautrock** — an experimental German rock movement from the 1970s known for its hypnotic, repetitive rhythms
- **Industrial music** — a harsh, mechanical electronic sound associated with artists like Nine Inch Nails

The result is a style that some are calling **"dance goth rock"** — music that is dark and atmospheric, but also built for the dancefloor.

### What Does *Childhood* Sound Like?

The EP opens in an unexpected way. Before any music begins, there is an **ambient recording** — what sounds like someone walking down a hallway. Then, swirling synth noise slowly builds before the first proper track, "Island in the Sky," launches into a **motorik beat**.

A motorik beat is a steady, driving rhythm pattern closely associated with Krautrock bands like Neu! and Can. It has a machine-like regularity that makes it almost impossible not to move to.

Layered over this rhythmic foundation are **vocals drenched in reverb** — the singer's voice is buried deep in a wash of echo and space, giving it a dreamy, distant quality. This sits in contrast to the pounding, physical energy of the rhythm section, creating a tension that makes the music feel both detached and urgent at the same time.

### A "Four-on-the-Floor" Dancefloor Sound

Another key feature of *Childhood* is its use of a **four-on-the-floor** rhythm — a beat pattern where the kick drum hits on every beat of the bar. This pattern is the foundation of dance music from disco to techno. When combined with Ashnymph's dark post-punk textures and industrial grime, it creates something genuinely exciting: goth music you can actually dance to.

### An Impressive Debut

*Childhood* is described as a **"thrilling opening salvo"** — a strong first statement from a band that clearly has a defined vision. Music critics and fans alike feel that Ashnymph is on the edge of a significant breakthrough. The EP shows a band that has already developed a mature, distinctive sound, even at this early stage of their career.

### What to Expect Next

For now, *Childhood* is only an EP, meaning it is a short release with just a few tracks. However, listeners are already eager for a full-length album. If Ashnymph can sustain the energy and creativity shown on this debut release, they could become one of the more important bands to emerge from London's underground scene in recent years.

For fans of dark, danceable music with depth and atmosphere, *Childhood* is absolutely worth your time.

## Kacey Musgraves Has Her Best Week Ever With New Album 'Middle of Nowhere'

Country and pop star Kacey Musgraves has had a huge week in the music world. Her new album, *Middle of Nowhere*, debuted at **No. 3** on the charts with 100,000 equivalent album units in its first week. This is the best opening-week performance of her entire career.

### What Is an 'Equivalent Album Unit'?

The music industry measures album sales using a system called "equivalent album units." This number includes not just physical and digital album sales, but also music streams and individual song downloads. So when we say Musgraves earned 100,000 units, it means a combination of all these different ways fans listened to and bought her music.

### How Does This Compare to Her Past Albums?

Musgraves is no stranger to success. Her 2024 album, *Deeper Well*, also had a strong opening week — but *Middle of Nowhere* performed even better. This shows that her fanbase is growing and that listeners are excited about her new musical direction.

Musgraves recently appeared on the cover of *Variety* magazine, which helped bring more attention to her new release. Magazine covers and media appearances are an important part of promoting an album, and it seems the extra publicity paid off for her.

### A Career Built on Authentic Storytelling

Kacey Musgraves first became well known with her 2013 debut album *Same Trailer Different Park*, which won the Grammy Award for Best Country Album. She became even more famous with her 2018 album *Golden Hour*, which won Album of the Year at the Grammys — one of the most prestigious awards in the music industry.

Over the years, Musgraves has been praised for writing honest, personal songs that mix country music with pop and psychedelic sounds. Her lyrics often talk about life in small towns, personal freedom, and following your own path. This unique style has helped her build a loyal and passionate fanbase around the world.

### Michael Jackson Also Makes Chart History

Musgraves was not the only big story in the charts this week. The late King of Pop, **Michael Jackson**, made headlines by landing **two albums** in the Top 10 at the same time. This is a remarkable achievement, especially for an artist who passed away in 2009.

Jackson's music continues to attract millions of listeners around the world. His albums frequently return to the charts when new content, documentaries, or anniversaries bring renewed public interest in his legacy.

### Why This Week Matters

This week's chart results are a reminder that the music industry is full of surprises. A living artist like Musgraves is breaking personal records, while a legendary artist like Michael Jackson continues to dominate the charts years after his death. For music fans, it was an exciting and historic week.

## Savannah Guthrie Posts Emotional Mother's Day Message for Her Missing Mom

Savannah Guthrie is a famous TV host in the United States. She hosts a popular morning show called *Today* on NBC. On Sunday, she shared a very emotional message on Instagram for Mother's Day.

### A Mother Who Is Missing

## Dua Lipa Sues Samsung for $15 Million

Famous British-Albanian pop star Dua Lipa is taking legal action against technology giant Samsung. She is demanding $15 million in damages. The lawsuit was filed in May 2026.

### What Happened?

Dua Lipa claims that Samsung used a copyrighted photograph of her on the packaging of their televisions. According to the singer, Samsung did this **without her permission**. Copyright law means that a person's image or creative work cannot be used commercially without their consent.

In simple terms, if a company wants to use a celebrity's photo to sell a product, they must first get that person's agreement — and usually pay for the right to use it. Dua Lipa says Samsung never asked her, and never paid her.

### Samsung Ignored the Warnings

Before going to court, Dua Lipa's legal team sent Samsung several **cease and desist letters**. A cease and desist letter is an official legal warning that tells a person or company to stop a certain action immediately. It is a common first step before filing a lawsuit.

However, according to the lawsuit, Samsung "refused to comply" with these requests. This means Samsung did not stop using the photo even after receiving the warnings. Because Samsung did not respond to the letters, Dua Lipa decided to take the matter to court.

### Why Is This a Big Deal?

This case highlights an important issue in both the music industry and the wider entertainment world: the right to control how your own image is used. Celebrities, like all people, have what is called **"image rights"** — the right to decide when and how their appearance is used for commercial purposes.

For big companies, using a well-known celebrity's face on a product can help attract customers. But doing so without permission is illegal and can result in large financial penalties.

A $15 million lawsuit is a very serious claim. If Dua Lipa wins the case, it could send a strong message to other companies about the importance of respecting image rights and copyright law.

### About Dua Lipa

Dua Lipa is one of the biggest pop stars in the world. She is known for hits like *Levitating*, *Don't Start Now*, and her critically praised album *Radical Optimism*. She has a massive global fanbase and a very recognisable public image, which makes her name and face extremely valuable in the commercial world.

The case is ongoing, and Samsung has not yet made a public statement in response to the lawsuit.

## Charli XCX Releases a New Song

Charli XCX has released a brand new song. The song is called **"I Keep On Thinking Bout You Every Single Day and Night"**. It came out in May 2026.

### Where Can You Listen to It?

This song is a little different from most new releases. You cannot find it on popular music streaming services like Spotify or Apple Music. Right now, there are only **two ways** to hear the song:

- **On vinyl** – You need to buy a physical vinyl record to listen to it.
- **On Charli XCX's Instagram** – She shared the song on her official Instagram page, so fans can listen there for free.

### What Is a B-Side?

The new song is the **B-side** to another song called **"Rock Music"**. But what does "B-side" mean?

In the past, music was sold on small round discs called **singles**. One side of the disc had the main song — this was called the "A-side." The other side had a second, bonus song — this was called the "B-side." The B-side was often less famous than the A-side, but fans loved finding and listening to these extra tracks.

Today, "B-side" still means a bonus or extra song that comes with a main release. It is usually only available in a special format, like vinyl.

### About Charli XCX

Charli XCX is a very popular British singer and songwriter. Her real name is Charlotte Emma Aitchison. She is known for her fun, energetic pop music and her unique style. In 2024, her album *Brat* became a huge hit around the world and was loved by both fans and music critics.

Charli XCX is also well known for connecting with her fans on social media. Sharing new music on Instagram is a great example of this. It makes her fans feel close to her and excited about her music.

### Why Is This Interesting?

It is unusual for a big artist to release a song **only on vinyl and Instagram**. Most artists want as many people as possible to hear their music, so they put it on streaming services. By keeping this song in a limited format, Charli XCX makes it feel special and exclusive. Fans who really want to hear it need to make an extra effort — and that makes the song even more exciting for them.
